## Verification

- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has deterministic tests.
- [ ] Reports and fixtures contain no secrets or personal data.
- [ ] New dependencies include a license and supply-chain review.
- [ ] Unsupported, missing, and indeterminate evidence still fails closed.
